phrases.english: 1.My God, You guided me but I diverted myself,
2.You admonished me but my heart became hardened,
3.You tried me graciously but I disobeyed.
4.Then, when You caused me to know it, I came to know that from
5.which You hadst turned [me] away, so I prayed forgiveness and You released, and I returned
6.and You covered over. So Thine, my God, is the praise!
7.I plunged into the valleys of destruction

phrases.arabic: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
phrases.english: 8.and settled in the ravines of ruin, exposing myself to Your chastisements
9.and the descent of Your punishments!
10.My mediation with You is the profession of Unity,

phrases.arabic: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
phrases.english: 11.my way of coming to You that I associate nothing with You,
12.nor do I take along with You a god;
13.I have fled to You with my soul -
14.in You is the place of flight for the evildoer,
15.the place of escape for him who has squandered the share of his soul and seeks asylum.

phrases.arabic: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 16.How many an enemy has unsheathed the sword of his enmity toward me,
17.honed the cutting edge of his knife for me,
18.sharpened the tip of his blade for me,
19.mixed his killing potions for me,
20.pointed toward me his straight-flying arrows,
21.not allowed the eye of his watchfulness to sleep toward me,

phrases.arabic: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ ،
phrases.english: 22.and secretly thought of visiting me with something hateful and making me gulp down the bitter water of his bile!

phrases.arabic: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ ،
phrases.english: 23.So You looked my God, at my weakness in bearing oppressive burdens,

phrases.arabic: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 24.my inability to gain victory over him who aims to war against me,

phrases.arabic: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
phrases.english: 25.and my being alone before the great numbers of him who is hostile toward me

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
phrases.english: 26.and lies in wait for me with an affliction about which I have not thought.
27.You set out at once to help me
28.and You braced up my back!
29.You blunted for me his blade,

phrases.arabic: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
phrases.english: 30.made him, after a great multitude, solitary,
31.raised up my heel over him,
32.and turned back upon him what he had pointed straight.
33.So You sent him back, his rage not calmed,
34.his burning thirst not quenched!
35.Biting his fingers,
36.he turned his back in flight, his columns having been of no use.
37.How many an oppressor has oppressed me with his tricks,
38.set up for me the net of his snares,
39.appointed over me the inspection of his regard,
40.and lay in ambush for me, the lying in ambush of a predator for its game,
41.waiting to take advantage of its prey,
42.while he showed me the smile of the flatterer
43.and looked at me with the intensity of fury!

phrases.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 44.So when You saw, my God, (blessed art You and high exalted) the depravity of his secret thoughts

phrases.arabic: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 45.and the ugliness of what he harboured, You threw him on his head into his own pitfall
46.and dumped him into the hole of his own digging.

phrases.arabic: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
phrases.english: 47.So he was brought down low, after his overbearing, by the nooses of his own snare,

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
phrases.english: 48.wherein he had thought he would see me;

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ  يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
phrases.english: 49.and what came down upon his courtyard - had it not been for Your mercy - was on the point of coming down upon me!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
phrases.english: 50.How many an evier has choked upon me in his agony,

phrases.arabic: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
phrases.english: 51.fumed over me in his rage, cut me with the edge of his tongue,
52.showed malice toward me by accusing me of his own faults,
53.made my good repute the target of his shots,
54.collared me with his own constant defects,
55.showed malice toward me with his trickery, and aimed at me with his tricks!
56.So I called upon You, my God, seeking aid from You,
57.trusting in the speed of Your response,

phrases.arabic: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
phrases.english: 58.knowing that he who seeks haven in the shadow of Your wing will not be mistreated,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ  لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
phrases.english: 59.and he who seeks asylum in the stronghold of Your victory will not be frightened.
60.So You fortified me against his severity through Your power.

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 61.How many a cloud of detested things You hast dispelled from me,
62.a cloud of favour You hast made rain down upon me,
63.a stream of mercy You hast let flow,
64.a well-being in which You hast clothed me, an eye of mishap You hast blinded,
65.and a wrap of distress You hast removed!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
phrases.english: 66.How many a good opinion You hast verified, a destitution You hast redressed,
67.an infirmity You hast restored to health, and a misery You hast transformed!
68.All of that was favour and graciousness from You,

phrases.arabic: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
phrases.english: 69.and in all of it I was occupied with acts of disobeying You.

phrases.arabic: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
phrases.english: 70.My evildoing did not hinder You from completing Your beneficence,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
phrases.english: 71.nor was I stopped from committing acts displeasing to You.

phrases.arabic: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
phrases.english: 72.You art not questioned as to what You dost! You wert asked, and You bestowed.

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
phrases.english: 73.You wert not asked, and You began. Your bounty was requested, and You didst not skimp.
74.You refused, my Master, everything but beneficence,
75.kindness, graciousness, and favour,
76.and I refused everything but plunging into what You hast made unlawful,
77.transgressing Your bounds, and paying no heed to Your threat!

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
phrases.english: 78.So Thine is the praise, my God, the All-powerful who is not overcome,
79.and the Possessor of patient waiting who does not hurry!

phrases.arabic: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
phrases.english: 80.This is the station of one who confesses to lavishness of favours,

phrases.arabic: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
phrases.english: 81.counters them with shortcomings, and bears witness to his own negligence.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
phrases.english: 82.O God, so I seek nearness to You through the elevated rank of Muhammad and the radiant degree of 'Ali,
83.and I turn to You through them so that You wilt give me

phrases.arabic: تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ [كَذَا وَكَذَا] فَإنَّ ذَالِكَ
phrases.english: 84.refuge from the evil of [so and so],
85.for that will not constrain You in Your wealth,
86.nor trouble You in Your power,
87.and You art powerful over everything!

phrases.arabic: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
phrases.english: 88.So give me, my God, by Your mercy and Your lasting bestowal of success,

phrases.arabic: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
phrases.english: 89.that which I may take as a ladder with which to climb to Your good pleasure

phrases.arabic: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
phrases.english: 90.and be secure from Your punishment, O Most merciful of the merciful!
